title: Armor Piercing Bullets: Hearing Before the Subcommittee on Crime
lineage: Two page images retained from the complete United States hearing. It reproduces agency chronology and testimony. The 1974–75 trial is distinct from the 1972 fabric-weaving event; numbers refer to pilot distribution, not population-wide use.

passages.note: Printed pp. 132–133 / PDF p. 69: 1974–75 multi-city wearability trials.
